verification.leaf_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of 'merkl-leaf-v1' || NUL || null-byte-separated UTF-8 fields: action_id, session_id, action_type, tool_name, input_hash_hex, output_hash_hex, timestamp_iso, drift_score_str, guardrail_result, display_name, depends_on_sorted_csv, status, category
verification.tree_algorithm: Binary Merkle tree — SHA-256(left_digest_bytes || right_digest_bytes). Odd-length levels: last leaf duplicated to next power of 2.
verification.audit_log_algorithm: SHA-256('merkl-entry-v1' || NUL || workspace_id_16_bytes || session_id_utf8 || session_root_32_bytes || leaf_count_8be || sealed_at_iso_utf8 || sequence_8be || prev_log_hash_32_bytes)
verification.continuation_algorithm: For successor sessions: leaf 0 = SHA-256('merkl-binding-v1' || NUL || parent_session_id_utf8 || parent_root_32_bytes || reason_utf8). Proving leaf 0 against successor.root ties the continuation to its parent cryptographically.
verification.log_tree_algorithm: RFC 6962 Merkle tree over audit log entry current_hash values in sequence order: leaf = SHA-256(0x00 || entry_hash), node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right). Inclusion and consistency proofs per RFC 9162 §2.1.
verification.anchor_algorithm: The checkpoint body digest is submitted to public OpenTimestamps calendars, which aggregate submissions into Bitcoin transactions. A pending attestation upgrades to a standalone Bitcoin proof once mined; verify with the ots client. Merkl cannot backdate an anchored checkpoint.
verification.checkpoint_algorithm: Ed25519 signature over the checkpoint body bytes (signed-note format: origin, tree_size, base64 root, 'time <unix>' lines, each newline-terminated). Verify with the advertised public key; compare key_id = first 8 bytes of SHA-256(public_key), hex.
